Elena —

Thanks for the heads up. Short answer: we can support either approach, and there are trade-offs depending on what OmniRetail needs for procurement and rollout. High level options we prefer to offer: 

1) Time-boxed extension (14 days) — no additional charges, same pilot SKU, includes standard onboarding support. Good when you only need more validation time and procurement doesn't require an amendment.

2) Credit top-up — we add X tokens of credit to the existing account that can be consumed across both staging and production. Credits are easier for procurement to accept as an add-on invoice.

3) Soft-launch incentive (conversion credit) — if OmniRetail converts to a reserved commitment within 30 days of pilot end we can provide a one-time conversion credit (pro-rated) and a 10% first-year volume discount. This is contingent on a signed SOW/PO.

Attachment: soft_launch_milestones.xlsx (proposed milestones & metrics)

If procurement prefers PO-driven invoicing, option 2 with a small top-up invoice usually moves fastest. If you want my sign-off for a one-time onboarding waiver (500k token warm-up) I can route a conditional approval — will check with pricing team.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call tomorrow to align.

Best,
Ben Carter

Elena / Samir / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick coordination. Per our internal review we can move forward with the following invoice-ready proposal: 

- Credit top-up: 600,000 tokens (invoiceable) — allocated to the primary billing ID. We will provide token transfer instructions so OmniRetail can route usage between staging and production internally.
- Time-boxed window: credits valid for 30 days from invoice date (covers your 2-week extra window + buffer).
- Conversion incentive: if OmniRetail signs a reserved commitment within 30 days of pilot end, Redwood will issue a one-time onboarding credit of 500,000 tokens applied to the first invoice and a 10% first-year volume discount (applies to annual/quarterly commit; discount prorated for quarterly).
- Implementation support: 4 hours of dedicated onboarding support (no charge) during the extension window.

Attachments: omni_proposal_v2.docx; redwood_trial_sku_sheet.pdf (detailed SKU/pricing table).

Next steps we need from OmniRetail to proceed:
1) Procurement PO for the 600k token top-up (invoice amount detailed in attached proposal).
2) Accept the attached DocuSign (link below) for the top-up SOW so we can start provisioning.
3) Schedule a 30-min kickoff with Samir and our onboarding team.
